caption: The drawing depicts a tall wooden chest of drawers with ornate detailing. The chest is reddish-brown in color, representing polished wood, and is adorned with multiple brass or gold-colored drawer handles and keyholes. The uppermost section features an elaborate broken pediment with scrolling, carved elements, flanked by two decorative urn finials. In the center of the pediment stands a bust of a woman atop a pedestal. The chest has thirteen drawers of varying sizes, arranged in a symmetrical layout; the top row contains three small drawers, the second row two drawers, and the remaining rows consist of single wide drawers, except for the lowest part where there are three smaller drawers, the center of which contains elaborate openwork scroll and floral designs. The legs of the chest are carved in a cabriole style, ending in claw-and-ball feet, and the lower edge features intricate carved patterns. The background is off-white, and the drawing is rendered with detailed linework and shading to highlight the textures and three-dimensional qualities of the wood and metal elements.
title: Highboy
